name: Joshikousei Houkago Seikyouiku ~Yowami o Nigitte Nama Hame Seikatsu Shidou~
original_name: 女子校生放課後性教育～弱みを握って生ハメ性活指導～
source:
Gym teacher Tsuyoshi Yokoya was a passionate coach but,
he was also passionate about spying on the girls in the lockers and the pool.

Given free access to all areas of campus, Yokoya installed cameras
so he could observe all the young, lithe bodies.
"It's a coach's duty to watch over their sexual development," he told himself.
Today, after classes and clubs had ended, he was watching footage of
gym class and masturbating.

Yokoya was slowly stroking to the footage when his cell phone rang.
He left the room to answer, and when he came back, student Ryoko Misaki was standing there.
She had some papers clutched in her hand, staring at the spy monitor.

If Yokoya let Misaki leave the room she'd tell everyone.
Caught in a predicament, he made the decision to educate her into silence.
Students rarely obey teachers, but he would be... thorough.

他还热衷于监视储物柜和游泳池里的女孩。

横屋安装了摄像头，可以免费进入校园的所有区域

“监督他们的性发育是教练的职责，”他告诉自己。
今天，课程和俱乐部结束后，他正在观看
体育课和自慰。

横也慢慢地抚摸着镜头，手机响了。
他离开房间去回答，当他回来时，学生岬凉子正站在那里。
她手里捏着一些文件，盯着间谍监视器。

如果横哉让美咲离开房间，她就会告诉所有人。
陷入困境的他决定教育她沉默。
学生很少服从老师，但他会……彻底。
